items.t: Airbag may deploy after a jolt (recall 97V-043)
items.job: Repair or replace airbag sensor computer
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: A ring cleaning treatment costs far less and sometimes helps. A used engine can cost less than a rebuild.

items.t: Unexpected airbag deployment from the airbag control module (recalls 13V-029, 15V-043)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive advisory, recall 15V-286)
items.note: Free under the airbag recall. Do not drive it; a dealer can tow it or send a mobile tech.

items.t: Door glass can come loose from the window regulator (recall 08V-162)
items.job: Reattach door glass to regulator with new bolts
items.note: Covered by the recall. Price is per door. If the regulator is damaged, it costs more.

items.t: Check engine light for catalyst efficiency (P0420)
items.note: Test the oxygen sensors and look for exhaust leaks first. Some states require a CARB-approved converter.

items.t: Oil leak at the timing chain tensioner or valve cover gasket
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket or tensioner O-ring

items.t: Lean code (P0171) from a vacuum leak or dirty airflow sensor
items.job: Smoke-test for vacuum leaks, clean airflow sensor, fix leak
items.note: If the airflow sensor has failed, replacing it costs more.

items.t: Engine computer can fail and stall the engine (recall 10V-384)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Accelerator pedal sticks or gets trapped (recalls 10V-017, 10V-023)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal assembly
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Brake booster vacuum port can freeze in extreme cold (recall 09V-338)
items.job: Replace intake vacuum connector for brake booster
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Airbag light from a damaged spiral cable (recall 14V-168)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Electric power steering drifts or wanders
items.job: Replace steering column with power steering motor
items.note: Check alignment first. Toyota's past steering coverage has likely ended; ask a dealer anyway.

items.t: Brief rattle at cold start from the cam timing gear (TSB T-SB-0087-09)
Oil consumption on the 2.4L engine (XRS)
items.note: Toyota's old ZE7 coverage has mostly ended; ask a dealer anyway. A used engine can cost less.

items.t: Power window master switch can overheat (recalls 12V-491, 15V-689)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Water pump leak or noise
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Starter or alternator failure
items.note: A starter replacement costs about the same. Test the battery first.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum
items.note: Price is per side.

items.t: Windshield wiper switch can short out (recall 13V-505)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: EVAP leak code from a misplaced fuel filler neck (TSB T-SB-0086-16)
items.job: Reposition fuel filler neck and clear EVAP code
items.note: Check this before buying EVAP parts such as the canister.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail (recalls 20V-012, 20V-682)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: CVT torque converter failure (recall 18V-901)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN and have it towed to a Toyota dealer.

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock in a second impact (recall 19V-877)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall 23V-865)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Driver airbag spiral cable weld can separate (recalls 23V-480, 25V-040)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Intermediate steering shaft can crack (recall 24V-878)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Headlight aim markings missing (recall 26V-110)
items.note: Covered by the recall. Price is for both lights. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid can lose power brake assist while turning (recall 24V-708)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-708. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cruise control may not hold the set speed (recall 96E-001)
items.note: Was free under recall 96E-001. Check the VIN with a dealer first.

items.t: Airbag computer may fail in a crash (recall 20V-024)
items.job: Inspect airbag control unit and add noise filter
items.note: Free under recall 20V-024. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Parking brake malfunction message on the display
items.job: Reprogram parking brake control, replace actuator if needed
items.note: Often software only; actuator replacement is the worst case.

items.t: Buzz or rattle from the right engine mount
Rattle from the headliner over the front seats
items.job: Secure headliner with pads and clips

items.t: Engine maintenance message keeps appearing on the cluster
items.note: Software update; no parts if nothing else is found.

items.t: Clicking from the front wheels at full steering lock
items.job: Inspect and service front suspension and axle joints
